name: gitdoc
description: Open-source documentation engine: render docs-as-files and serve them.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gitdocai/ui && npm run build -w @gitdocai/render && npm run build -w @gitdocai/server && node scripts/assemble-engine.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gitdocai/ui && npm run typecheck -w @gitdocai/render
